title: St. Andrea Nagy-Eged 2022
subtitle: Egri Bikavér Grand Superior · 2022 · Eger, Hungary

rows.label: Mouthfeel
rows.value: High acidity; high, finely polished tannins.

winemaking.note: Egri Bikavér (“Bull’s Blood of Eger”) is a red blend from the Eger area, based on Kékfrankos. Grand Superior is the highest of its three tiers.

rows.label: Ageing potential
rows.value: over 10 years: decades of ageing potential

producer.html: St. Andrea is a winery in Egerszalók, in the Eger wine district of Hungary’s Upper-Hungary wine region. It was founded in 2002 and has 50 hectares of vineyard, producing about 250,000 bottles a year.

rows.label: Region
rows.value: Upper-Hungary wine region; Eger wine district

rows.label: Zone
rows.value: The Eger designation area, 19 municipalities among them Eger, Egerszalók and Noszvaj; Grand Superior grapes come from vineyards in soil-cadastre classes I and II/1

rows.label: Site
rows.value: Nagy-Eged, a named vineyard (dűlő) in Eger, 260–330 m above sea level, on marine limestone sediments and brown forest soil

rows.label: Climate
rows.value: Eger area, 47-year averages: 10.65 °C annual mean temperature, 592.6 mm annual precipitation, 1,964 hours of sunshine a year

designation.intro: Egri Bikavér is a classification within the protected designation of origin Eger/Egri (oltalom alatt álló eredetmegjelölés). The table compares its product specification (termékleírás) with this wine.

table.meaning: The grapes must come from the designation area, the vineyards of 19 municipalities around Eger.

Three tiers: Classicus, Superior and Grand Superior. Grand Superior has the lowest maximum yield (35 hl/ha, against 60 for Superior and 100 for Classicus) and is the only tier that may name a vineyard.
At least 4 grape varieties, each above 5% of the wine. Kékfrankos must make up 30–65% and be the largest share.
At least 12.0% vol actual alcohol content (tényleges alkoholtartalom). The total alcohol content (összes alkoholtartalom) must be at least 12.5% vol.
At least 12 months in wooden barrels (fahordó) for Superior and Grand Superior Bikavér.
Allowed only on Grand Superior. At least 95% of the grapes must come from the named vineyard.
table.this_wine: Nagy-Eged, a listed vineyard in Eger

table.meaning: At most 5 g/L total sugar in Classicus, Superior and Grand Superior Bikavér.
The vintage year must appear on the label.
